disposition_mapping.rationale: The confirmation survives as a mandatory, named human attestation (FSP-R-10, KB-03), but the underlying status-gathering is restructured around continuous automated monitoring rather than periodic manual checking. Council converged (pragmatist, finance_domain, emerging_economy, hitl_designer, accounting_standards) that the dashboard may be an input to the confirmation but cannot substitute for it; a discrete, timestamped attestation event is preserved.

Mechanical postings are automated against the approved schedule; judgmental postings (provisions, impairments) retain a named accountable preparer with a documented basis per KB-04/KB-10, as finance_domain, hitl_designer and accounting_standards all required. Both required inputs (approved adjustment schedule, revenue cut-off evidence) remain explicit, named inputs to this step, satisfying FSP-R-02 and FSP-R-06.

Kept as its own step rather than merged with translation, per the majority position (finance_domain, accounting_standards, hitl_designer, and agentic_architect's round-2 concession) that KB-14's completeness assertion needs its own identifiable evidentiary output distinct from the translation-difference artifact. Resequenced to run after translation (TS-03) per the uncontested correction that eliminating balances still sitting in mixed currencies is a defect. Matching is automated with mandatory escalation of unmatched items to the Group accountant; intercompany balances/transactions remain an explicit required input (FSP-R-03).

Moved ahead of consolidation/elimination, correcting the baseline's sequencing error that every council member endorsed in round 2. Kept as a step distinct from FSP-03 so that OCI-bound translation differences remain separately tracked and reported per KB-07/KB-08, rather than risk being netted into elimination workpapers. Closing and average exchange rates remain an explicit required input (FSP-R-04); rate application is automated with human review reserved for unusual movements.

Retained as a discrete checkpoint rather than folded into drafting, per the near-unanimous view (pragmatist, finance_domain, hitl_designer, agentic_architect, emerging_economy) that the mapping table is itself an auditable artifact and that unmapped/reclassified accounts are a real, recurring exception population. Mapping is automated against a locally-maintainable, non-vendor-locked rule table, with exceptions routed to Financial reporting. Statement line-item structure remains an explicit required input (FSP-R-05).

Survives as required by FSP-R-11. AI-assisted first-pass drafting is permitted, but the accountable drafter of record remains Financial reporting, which owns all judgment calls on policy-change and prior-period-error disclosure per KB-05/KB-06, as hitl_designer and emerging_economy insisted. The policy-change/error record remains an explicit required input (FSP-R-07), and the actor remains distinct from the approving CFO (FSP-R-08).

Despite being unconstrained_by_design, the council (pragmatist, finance_domain, emerging_economy, hitl_designer, accounting_standards, and maximalist's eventual concession) converged that this checkpoint must survive as a genuinely distinct, independently performed review, because KB-02's evidential-trail principle is general and does not lapse merely because no bespoke requirement was drafted for this step. Mechanical tie-out is automated; variance analysis above threshold is read and explained by a human reviewer who receives the full evidence log rather than a pre-filtered exception list, resolving the hitl_designer/maximalist dispute in favour of genuine analytical review.

Survives as required by FSP-R-09 and remains actor-distinct from drafting per FSP-R-08, a control the council treated as absolute (emerging_economy, accounting_standards, finance_domain). Per hitl_designer and agentic_architect's round-2 agreement, the approval packet must carry the full upstream exception trail rather than a filtered AI-ranked summary, so the CFO's review is evidence-rich rather than ceremonial.

Kept as a step distinct from approval, rejecting maximalist's single 'approve-and-release' action: the majority (finance_domain, emerging_economy, hitl_designer, accounting_standards) held that release is an external transmission event with its own governance obligations and that collapsing it into approval removes the buffer that catches a conditional approval. The executing actor shifts from CFO to Financial reporting, acting strictly under the CFO's prior approval token, following the design pragmatist proposed and finance_domain and emerging_economy explicitly accepted in round 2; the approval and release events remain separately timestamped and the released artifact must be provably identical to what was approved.

steps.description: A close-readiness agent continuously polls subledger close status and the reconciliation status report, surfacing open items on a dashboard. The GL accountant reviews the surfaced exceptions and performs a discrete, timestamped attestation that the trial balance is closed and reconciled. The attestation is an affirmative act distinct from the system status feed, not a passive dashboard state, and the close can be reopened if a problem surfaces later. Automation removes manual status-chasing; it does not remove the named human confirmation that fires the period gate.
steps.name: Close readiness confirmation

steps.description: Mechanical entries (recurring accruals, standard deferrals, templated cut-off postings) are posted by an adjustment-posting agent directly from the approved schedule, with automated validation against revenue cut-off evidence. Judgmental entries (provisions, impairments, NRV write-downs) retain a named accountable preparer who sets or approves the assumptions and documents the basis before posting, not after. Any schedule/evidence mismatch or missing approval reference is routed to the GL accountant as an exception and is never auto-overridden. GL accountant capacity freed from mechanical keying is redeployed into judgmental-entry review and exception resolution.
steps.name: Post period-end adjustments

steps.description: Corrected from baseline sequencing: each foreign subsidiary's adjusted trial balance is translated into the presentation currency before consolidation, so that intercompany matching never has to operate on mixed-currency balances. Closing and average rate application is mechanical and agent-executed against a locally-maintainable, inspectable rate table (not vendor-locked), but exchange differences above a defined threshold, and any unusual movement, are surfaced to the Group accountant for review before being treated as routine and taken to OCI. Translation differences are logged as their own separately dated artifact, distinct from any elimination workpaper.
steps.name: Translate foreign operation

steps.description: Now sequenced after translation (FSP-04) rather than before it. Entity trial balances, including the translated subsidiary trial balance, are combined and intercompany balances/transactions are matched and eliminated by an automated matching engine against locally-maintainable elimination rules. Unmatched or mismatched intercompany items are hard-stopped and escalated to the Group accountant for resolution; the engine cannot force a match or suppress a residual to produce a clean consolidation. A distinct elimination-completeness schedule is produced and logged separately from the translation-difference artifact, so the two assurances (full elimination per IFRS 10; visible, non-netted exchange differences per IAS 21) remain independently inspectable even though both computations share one orchestration layer. Group accountant capacity shifts from manual matching to exception resolution and completeness attestation.
steps.name: Consolidation and intercompany elimination

steps.description: The consolidated trial balance and translation differences are mapped to statement line items via an agent-executed, rules-based mapping table maintained locally (not held exclusively inside a proprietary vendor platform, so the local team can operate the mapping manually if the platform is unavailable). New, reclassified, or otherwise unmapped accounts are routed to Financial reporting as a named exception rather than defaulted by a system guess. The mapping table and any manual override are logged.
steps.name: Map trial balance to statement line items

steps.description: An AI drafting assistant generates a first-pass draft of statements and notes from the mapped data and the policy-change/prior-period-error record, but Financial reporting remains the accountable drafter of record: it reviews, edits, and owns every narrative judgment, especially the characterisation and disclosure of policy changes and prior-period errors, which cannot be left to generated language without human authorship. This step remains organisationally distinct from, and performed by a different actor than, management approval.
inputs: Accounting policy change and prior-period error record
steps.name: Draft primary statements and key notes

steps.description: Retained as a genuine, separately performed checkpoint between drafting and CFO review, not absorbed into either neighbour: a straight-through pipeline is not self-certifying, and the independent check is exactly what KB-02's evidential-trail principle requires. An agent performs the mechanical tie-out of the draft to the trial balance, the elimination-completeness schedule, and the translation-difference log, and runs variance/analytical checks against prior period and budget. Clean ties require no human touch, but variance items above a defined materiality threshold must be read and explained, not merely acknowledged, by a Financial reporting reviewer who receives the full structured evidence log (not a pre-filtered summary) so they can catch issues the automated flagging logic did not anticipate.
steps.name: Analytical review and tie-out

steps.description: Retained unchanged in substance and kept actor-distinct from drafting. The CFO's approval packet carries forward the full exception trail generated upstream (close-readiness exceptions, judgmental-entry basis memo, intercompany elimination completeness schedule, translation differences, unmapped-account log, tie-out evidence and variance exception log) rather than a sanitised summary, so the review is a genuine second look grounded in evidence rather than a rubber stamp over a clean dashboard. Approval produces an authorization token that gates release.
steps.name: Management review and approval

steps.description: Kept as a step distinct from approval, since approval is an internal governance decision and release is the external transmission event with its own filing-window and simultaneous-disclosure obligations; collapsing them would remove the buffer that catches a conditional approval whose open item is not yet resolved. The mechanical packaging, filing and distribution is executed by Financial reporting, strictly gated on receipt of the CFO's approval authorization token, so that the act is separately timestamped from approval while the CFO remains accountable for the underlying decision. The released artifact must be provably identical to the approved one, and the release action itself is logged and retractable through a controlled correction path rather than silently overwritten.
steps.name: Release / submission
